name: Pixel Truth
tagline: A Roblox city whose trust meter rises or collapses with the information players choose to believe.
problem: It has never been easier to make credible-looking false information, the team says.
solution: Players talk to characters and judge headlines and posts; accurate choices raise a city-wide trust meter, misinformation lowers it until the city visibly falls apart.
demo_moment: Team-described: let misinformation spread and watch the skyline darken and burn.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Makes the abstract idea of trust in information visible.

lessons: Give an abstract value a visible meter and a dramatic failure state.
